faq_heading: New construction in Tsawwassen: your questions answered

faq.q: What counts as new construction on this page?
faq.a: Active MLS® listings in Tsawwassen where the board's age field is 0 or less: homes finished this year and homes listed before completion, in houses, townhomes and condos.

faq.q: Where are the newest homes in Tsawwassen?
faq.a: Over the past year the newest sold homes were duplexes in Boundary Beach: median build year 2026, 9 sales, median price $1,299,900.

faq.q: How fast do newer homes sell in Tsawwassen?
faq.a: The quickest group among the newer ones was townhomes in Boundary Beach: 4 days to sell at a median, closing at 100.0% of the list price.

blocks.text: Every listing in the search above is an active MLS® listing in Tsawwassen with the board's age field set to 0 or less, meaning completed this year or listed ahead of completion. Houses, townhomes and condos are included, and land and income properties are not. A lot of presale homes are sold by the developer and do not appear on the MLS® until near completion, which means the search is a part of the new-home market, not all of it.
What newer homes in Tsawwassen have sold for
The most recently built homes that sold in Tsawwassen from November 2025 to October 2026 were duplexes in Boundary Beach. Their median build year was 2026; 9 sold at a median of $1,299,900.

5 of 17 sub-area and home-type groups with 5 or more sales had a median build year of 2020 or later. The newest were Boundary Beach duplexes (built 2026), Boundary Beach townhomes (built 2024), Boundary Beach condos (built 2024) and Tsawwassen North condos (built 2021).

blocks.text: Tsawwassen overall: what sold over the past year

items.t: Across Tsawwassen, 158 houses sold at a median of $1,499,500, with the middle half between $1,332,500 and $1,839,925. They took 20 days and closed at 97.2% of the list price, and the median build year was 1976. The typical house sat on a lot of about 7,869 square feet. The median moved from $1,540,000 (November to January) to $1,415,000 (August to October).

Tsawwassen townhomes over the past year: 60 sales, a median of $767,450, and a middle half from $696,875 to $892,500. The median home was built in 2020, took 35 days to sell and closed at 97.9% of list. Strata fees were a median $436 a month. The median moved from $750,000 (November to January) to $700,000 (August to October).

Across Tsawwassen, 97 condos sold at a median of $585,000, with the middle half between $485,000 and $661,000. They took 44 days and closed at 97.0% of the list price, and the median build year was 2006. Strata fees were a median $520 a month. The median moved from $587,500 (November to January) to $645,000 (August to October).

Tsawwassen duplexes over the past year: 21 sales, a median of $1,299,900, and a middle half from $1,199,900 to $1,450,000. The median home was built in 2026, took 16 days to sell and closed at 99.1% of list. Strata fees were a median $655 a month.

Planning and zoning notes for Tsawwassen

items.t: Delta's Official Community Plan is Bylaw No. 8400 (2024). It folded the former area plans, including the Tsawwassen Area Plan from the previous OCP (Bylaw No. 3950), into a single Land Use Plan.
Delta Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, section 6.2.3, sets a waterfront setback for lots on Boundary Bay along Beach Grove Road south of 16 Avenue; it lets a seawall extend into the minimum front setback.
